description: Dataset-level catalog: what exists, where it lives, what it can/can't support. No raw third-party data committed.

datasets.access: metadata only in repo; download separately under repository terms
datasets.name: Mendeley sucker rod failure data (DOI 10.17632/42jnkpp5tv.1)
datasets.why_relevant: Only openly catalogued rod/tubing failure dataset found; directly relevant to future failure modeling.

datasets.access: open data platform (Equinor/Databricks); NOT in repo
datasets.name: Equinor Volve open field data (2008-2016)
datasets.why_relevant: Most complete open production time-series release; teaches pipeline shapes, not Baghewala physics.

datasets.access: papers only; no raw cards in repo
datasets.name: SRP dynamometer-card literature (Mossoro, China, methods repo)
datasets.why_relevant: Establishes what SRP failure data looks like and how the field models it.

can_support: feature-matrix shape validation for future ML
datasets.name: Synthetic Baghewala-constrained telemetry (seeded)
datasets.why_relevant: Only granular well-level records available; every record labeled synthetic with generator version + seed.

datasets.access: public aggregate facts in provenance.json; no time series
datasets.name: Baghewala field evidence (aggregates)
datasets.why_relevant: Only Baghewala-specific public evidence class available.

telemetry_availability_statement: Public Baghewala data includes field-level information and a subset of well-specific historical/status/CSS/production records (5 verified wells: BGW-01, BGW-04, BGW-08, BGW-17, BGW-40; see baghewala_well_coverage.json). Complete continuous well-by-well SCADA telemetry was not found publicly.
